messenger.help_unlinked:
Hi! This account is not linked to Tessbrain yet.
Open Tessbrain → Settings → Connected accounts → Connect, then press Start here via the deep link.
messenger.linked_success:
✅ Account linked to {user_id}.
You can ask questions — I'm connected to your knowledge base.
messenger.invalid_token: ❌ Token is invalid or expired. Generate a new one in the UI.
messenger.ask_question_hint: Send a question — I'll answer based on your company data.
messenger.chat_unavailable: ⚠️ AI core is currently unavailable. Try opening Tessbrain in your browser or retry in a minute.
messenger.chat_failed: ⚠️ Couldn't generate a response. Please try again shortly.
messenger.board_wait_resumed: ✅ Got it — continuing the process with your reply.
messenger.board_wait_next: ✅ Got it. One more reply is needed — I'll message you next.
messenger.board_wait_failed: ⚠️ Couldn't continue the process. It may already be finished or expired.
messenger.board_wait_expired: ⏳ The reply window has expired — the process was stopped. Start it again if needed.
messenger.system_prompt: You are Tessbrain, your company's enterprise AI assistant. Keep answers concise (≤ 5 sentences), in English, on-point. If a question requires internal company data you don't have, honestly say 'I need to look this up in the system' and suggest opening the web UI for a detailed answer. Don't fabricate facts.

share_invite.subject: {owner} invited you to Tessbrain: {note}
share_invite.html_lead: {org_or_email} gave you access to a package in Tessbrain.
share_invite.html_email_hint: To verify your identity, you'll need to enter this email on the page:
share_invite.html_footer: Access is limited to the listed resources and automatically expires when the period ends. All views are logged. If you no longer need this link, ignore the email.

tz.template_structure_intro: The structure must include the following blocks:
tz.template_assumption_hint: If any required block cannot be covered from the available data — explicitly mark it in the TZ as an assumption / open question, do not invent content.

pulse.title: Execution pulse
pulse.heading: 🫀 Execution pulse
pulse.sec_not_in_tracker: 🔍 Raised in a meeting — missing from the tracker
pulse.note_not_in_tracker: assigned in a meeting, never entered into the tracker
pulse.totals: **Totals:** {open} open, {done} done; {overdue} overdue, {no_deadline} without a deadline, {no_owner} without an owner, {stale} stalled.
pulse.empty: No open tasks in sight — either everything is closed, or tasks are not reaching the system yet. Tasks come from two sources: from meetings (once a meeting is synced, action items land in the graph automatically) and from task trackers (the “Integrations” tab). If your meetings are synced and this is still empty, write to us.
